payload.text: A CLIENT's name, or the name of a client's project, never appears anywhere in devbin: the tree, issues, boards, canon events, commit messages or release notes (hv, 2026-10-05: "mentioning CLIENT names and projects is an UNFORGIVABLE FIRING SQUAD offence"). A session named after client work is a client name too; in devbin's record it is "another estate's session". hv's own projects may be named in docs and commits, but never by their local directories, never as a dependency, and never in shipped code (bin/devbin and lib/).
